rng: NumPy PCG64; SeedSequence(20571).spawn(4), stream order fixed in implementation

metric.definition: mmd2_linear_biased_fixed_features = squared Euclidean difference of frozen 421 feature means
metric.feature_scaling: length/48, per-sequence AA fractions, per-sequence dipeptide fractions; each block divided by sqrt(3)
metric.fitting: none; no new kernel/bandwidth/feature fit or selection
metric.eligibility: preserve all 16 requests and statuses; distribution features use canonical sequences length 1 through 48 as frozen evaluator; generation resampling unit remains all request slots, invalid draws counted then omitted from feature mean, empty feature set null
metric.train_dev_description: within each terminal: fixed feature mean/std/min/max, signed mean difference; length counts/quantiles; cohort and component counts; MMD decomposed into exactly additive length/AA/dipeptide contributions

train_reference_design.sequence_without_replacement: each terminal uniform 16 sequence-row subset without replacement, compared with complete fixed same-terminal dev18/23
train_reference_design.whole_component_exact_16_16: uniform over all feasible subsets of complete frozen train NW70 components jointly totaling FREE16 and AMD16; DP integer suffix counts and exact integer branch sampling; unequal sequence inclusion is allowed; not independent per-terminal draws
train_reference_design.reuse: only reviewed DP helper code reused; newly locked 2048 indices; old latent cache is not read or relabeled
train_reference_design.target: complete fixed dev18/23 for both schemes; no overlapping full-train target or leftover-train panel
train_reference_design.analytic_check: SRSWOR only: full-train-vs-dev MMD + (N-n)/(n*(N-1))*mean_i||phi_i-mean_train||^2, mean denominator N; report Monte Carlo mean minus exact expectation, no pass threshold
train_reference_design.generated_position: for each of 4 methods each terminal, observed generation16-vs-dev MMD located in each finite train-reference distribution; count less/exact-ties/greater and midrank/tie interval; no pvalue/null/adequacy threshold

bootstrap_design.generation_only: independent with-replacement samples of 16 fixed request slots for CE/AR and each terminal; complete fixed dev
bootstrap_design.development_components_only: draw exactly 33 dev component IDs with replacement jointly; expand entire selected components with multiplicity, retaining cross-terminal correlation; use original 16 generation slots
bootstrap_design.joint: reuse exact generation-only draw and exact dev-component-only draw within each repetition; no extra random stream
bootstrap_design.pairing: all methods use same dev row multiplicities within repetition; CE and AR generation draws are independent, not paired noise
bootstrap_design.estimand: sequence-weighted within-terminal fixed-feature mean under empirical whole-component resampling, a ratio with random terminal n; not equally weighted component means
bootstrap_design.missing_terminal: n=0 stays null; no rejection/refill/truncation; equal-terminal CE-minus-AR average null unless both terminal differences defined
bootstrap_design.report: all per-repetition MMD block values and effective n; per-terminal CE-minus-AR and equal-terminal mean; mean/std0/min/max/q025/q50/q975 plus defined/undefined counts; per-panel dev n histogram
bootstrap_design.scope: only CE and AR; source-replacement B/C/D excluded

interpretation: All quantities are descriptive diagnostics conditional on the frozen features, current train/dev split, four saved single-seed fitted pipelines and 16-request batches.

Train-resampling reference comprises sequences the models were trained on and complete repeatedly reused dev; it is not model-unseen validation, a null distribution, a superiority gate, or an adequacy threshold.
Bootstrap quantiles are finite empirical sensitivity ranges conditional on the fixed fit; not population confidence intervals, pvalues, formal significance, or training-seed uncertainty.

Each generated sequence request is a resampling unit; neither residues nor 421 coordinates are independent replicate units. At n16, centered sample covariance rank is at most15. Mean-feature MMD does not identify full sequence-distribution equality.
Dev component resampling preserves the two cross-terminal components by shared whole-component multiplicities; terminal sample sizes vary and missing terminals stay null.

Single seed and repeated dev use remain limitations. AR adequacy remains NOT_ESTABLISHED; original CE protocol E/L/G permanently NOT_EVALUABLE; recovery descriptive gates are not recomputed or changed; PROMOTE remains HOLD.
Source-replacement C was coordinate permutation of B decoder-z, not a mu/log-sigma pairing experiment; B/C/D are outside this diagnostic input scope.
